lines: Bears have an amazing sense of smell.
They use a large part of their brain for smell.
They find food from far away.
Cows have an amazing sense of taste.
They have lots of taste buds on their tongue.
They eat safe plants with no poison.
Spiders have an amazing sense of touch.
They have tiny hairs on their legs.
body.text: Bears have an amazing sense of smell. They use a large part of their brain for smell. They find food from far away. Cows have an amazing sense of taste. They have lots of taste buds on their tongue. They eat safe plants with no poison. Spiders have an amazing sense of touch. They have tiny hairs on their legs. They feel their predators coming. Then they run away.
